name: Waters of Unfathomable Compulsion
description: Any creature that drinks the water of a creature or eats fruit from the plants growing in it has a dream (as the spell, save DC 16) the next time it sleeps. In this dream, the creature places a compulsion to carry out some activity as a torrent of images and sensations. When the creature awakens, it is affected by a geas spell (save DC 168, cast as a 7th-level spell) in addition to the effects of dream.
